headline: Gibbs Goes Nuclear, Browning Out Goes Dark, And Stroud Boys Lose By A Jameis
subhead: T Swift's Baddies dropped a buck-eighty, Nut Olave hung a 170, and somewhere in Houston Patrick is checking if his lineup even submitted.
matchOfTheWeek: The Good Ladds 118 — Stroud Boys 116.12, decided by a Brissett-sized margin of 1.88. The kicker? Jameis Winston dropped 33.24 on the Stroud Boys bench while Davis Mill$ presumably did Davis Mill$ things in the starting lineup. Bjewett left 31.74 on the pine and lost by less than two — that's not a loss, that's a self-inflicted gunshot wound with the safety still on.
powerRankingsShakeup: T Swift's Baddies just put up 182.54 and look like the scariest team in the league, while Browning Out is in full free-fall after getting curb-stomped by 63 by a guy whose entire roster is named after a porn pun.
mainRecap:
Let's start at the top, because Jahmyr Gibbs put up FIFTY-FIVE POINT FOUR on T Swift's Baddies and singlehandedly turned McBride's lineup into roadkill. Tnicolle scored 182.54, hit 'em with a 39-point beatdown, and STILL left Colston Loveland's 16.9 on the bench like she was saving him for dessert. Largest of Rocks ran a 98.3% efficient lineup and lost by 40 — congrats, you optimally got your ass kicked, frame the printout.

Nut Olave Your Face dropped 170 on Browning Out and it wasn't even that competitive. My Njigba went for 37, Emanuel Wilson — yes, that Emanuel Wilson — chipped in 26, and DJ Moore put up 23.4 ON THE BENCH because Nick has so much firepower he's literally hoarding it. Patrickreegs scored 107. That's not a fantasy team, that's a participation certificate. Browning Out indeed — lights off, doors locked, season cooked.

OnlyFants beat Rub My Chubb by 37 in the most uncomfortably-named matchup in fantasy history. BigD scored 102, the lowest output of the week, and somewhere a chubb was decidedly NOT rubbed. Cubby left John Metchie's 18.5 on the bench and still cruised — when you can afford that kind of waste, you're cooking.

Egbukkake handled QAmon 146-120 behind Perc Hurts (30.86) and Giant Hog HHH Henry going full TE1 with 28. ShAmon-Ra dropped 29.9 for Kyle and it didn't matter because the rest of his lineup looked like a Tiny-Handed Vampire fever dream. Meanwhile Christian McCalfinjury's namesake actually played and scored 27.2, Dak added 28, and Mattwunder dispatched Little Peckers despite George Pickens going for 29.6. 7BigPapi7, your team is named Little Peckers and you got got — the jokes write themselves.

weeklyAwards.title: Bench Coach of the Year
weeklyAwards.blurb: Lost by 1.88 with 33 points of Jameis Winston rotting on the bench — that's not bad luck, that's malpractice.

weeklyAwards.title: Lights Out Award
weeklyAwards.blurb: 107 points, blown out by 63, and your team name is now a literal description of your playoff odds.

weeklyAwards.title: Stat-Padder Supreme
weeklyAwards.blurb: Gibbs goes for 55.4, you hang 182, and you're still benching 16.9 from Loveland just to flex on everyone.

weeklyAwards.title: Optimally Cooked
weeklyAwards.blurb: 98.3% lineup efficiency and still got smoked by 40 — peak performance, peak humiliation.
